brand_identity.user_persona: LeoHoca (Developer, Web Designer, IT Expert, Social Media Strategist)
brand_identity.aesthetic: Deep cinematic obsidian/navy command terminal, glowing electric cyan rings, frosted tactical glass, holographic central AI orb with real-time responsive states, micro-grid scanning line, zero SaaS fluff.

entry_surfaces./login: cinematic obsidian lockscreen — glowing biometric PIN keypad + Q8Ka holographic crest left, secure neural entry console right
entry_surfaces./: futuristic command center hero — top biometric telemetry ribbon, central multi-layered reactive JARVIS Orb with audio spectrum, live operational widgets (Bugünkü İşler, Öncelikli Sistem Görevleri, AI İşlem Akışı, Hızlı Ses/Terminal Komutları) and ambient grid matrix

rules.overlines: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-mono font-semibold text-[#00F0FF]

IDLE.description: Subtle breathing cyan core with 3 concentric rotating holographic rings and low-frequency floating nodes

LISTENING.description: Green-cyan energetic radar sweep with reactive audio frequency bars expanding outward

THINKING.description: Deep violet-cyan vortex with swirling neural particle rays and quantum compression ripple

SPEAKING.description: Kinetic electric blue sonar rings radiating outwards with center core size pulsing in sync with speech

layers: 1. Ambient SVG background circular coordinate reticle + degree tick marks
2. Counter-rotating segmented SVG dashed orbital rings (motion/react animate={{ rotate: 360 }})
3. Core radial gradient canvas/CSS glowing sphere with inner refraction highlight
4. Real-time Audio Visualizer spectrum ring (16 vertical neon bars orbiting the sphere)
5. Center state badge & micro-telemetry data readout (Hz frequency, Memory load, Latency 14ms)

mobile_pwa_shell.header: Sticky top glass HUD with Q8Ka branding, current active state & quick voice trigger
mobile_pwa_shell.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-[#080E1E]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-[#00F0FF]/20 flex items-center justify-around z-50 px-2 pb-safe

visual_enhancers.background_matrix: Subtle dark slate blue cyber grid overlay with opacity 0.15 + cyan linear gradient beam scanline
visual_enhancers.sound_wave_effects: Live CSS bar height animation responding to simulated speech/input
visual_enhancers.corner_brackets: Tactical cyber corner markers on critical widgets (top-left, bottom-right 4px cyan L-shapes)

rules: Smooth entrance staggered transitions with opacity and translateY(10px)
Orb rotation using infinite linear transforms with hardware acceleration
Hover states for tactical buttons: neon glow expansion and 2px border highlight
Strict respect for prefers-reduced-motion media queries

accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY on all buttons, inputs, tabs, orb trigger, chat forms, task checkboxes, PIN keys
accessibility.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA guaranteed: primary text #E2F1FF on #050811 is 16.5:1; muted text #7B96B2 is 5.2:1
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria live regions for JARVIS voice status notifications and AI message stream

instructions_to_main_agent.branding_rule: Prominently display the brand 'Q8Ka By Leohoca' in the HUD header and login shield. Show LeoHoca's profile context (Yazılımcı, Web Tasarımcı, IT & Sosyal Medya Uzmanı).
instructions_to_main_agent.turkish_language: Entire UI copy, system status labels, prompts, and preset commands must be in natural, professional, futuristic Turkish (e.g., 'SİSTEM HAZIR', 'SESLİ DİNLENİYOR', 'ANALİZ EDİLİYOR', 'YAPAY ZEKA YANITI', 'İŞLEM GEÇMİŞİ').
instructions_to_main_agent.orb_interactivity: Make the JARVIS Orb clickable to toggle states (Idle -> Listening -> Thinking -> Speaking) with real speech synthesis/recognition capabilities where supported, and interactive audio visualizer waves.
instructions_to_main_agent.css_theme_entry: In frontend/src/index.css, configure Space Grotesk for headings (@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk), Geist for body (@fontsource-variable/geist), JetBrains Mono for telemetry codes (@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono). Set dark mode default in frontend/index.html.
instructions_to_main_agent.avoid_fluff: NO generic SaaS placeholder bar charts. Replace with tactical cyber widgets: Real-time System Load, Neural Memory Slots, AI Operations Log, Priority Task Matrix, Turkish Quick Command Hub.
